summary.alreadyInFortnox: {count} days are already in Fortnox and are flagged
summary.fortnoxCheckFailed: Could not be checked against Fortnox
summary.fortnoxCheckSeriesUnset: Could not be checked against Fortnox because no voucher series is chosen

lines.accountFailed: The account could not be changed.
lines.unknownPrefix: A prefix no committee has, {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}
lines.selectPrefix: Select every product with the prefix {prefix}

move.title: Move sales
move.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from {from}
move.mergeBody: {unit} already has a report for {date}. {count, plural, one {# item moves} other {# items move}} into it and the two days become one. You cannot split them again.
move.dragHint: Drag onto another committee's report for the same day
move.destinationHint: The items join that committee's report for the same day. If it has none, one is created.
move.destinationRequired: Pick where the items are moving to
move.noAccounts: This committee has no product prefixes. Pick an account for each row.
move.stillOnOldAccount: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} still on the account they had in the fallback report. Is that right?
move.confirm: Move {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
move.done: {count, plural, one {# item moved} other {# items moved}}
move.failed: The items could not be moved.

newReport.title: New report
newReport.subtitle: {date} - {source}. An empty report to move sales onto.
newReport.unitRequired: Pick whose takings the report becomes
newReport.alreadyExists: That committee already has a report for the day, so that one opens instead. Two reports for one day could not both be booked.
newReport.opened: That committee already had a report for the day. It is open now.
newReport.failed: The report could not be created.
newReport.emptyBody: This report holds no sales yet. Drag items onto it from another report for the same day, or select them there and choose Move. Wrong committee: delete this report and make another.
newReport.deleteBody: {unit} {date} holds no sales. The report will be removed.
newReport.deleteFailed: The report could not be deleted.

undo.unexportBody: Voucher {voucher} stays in Fortnox. All this does is stop the app counting the day as exported. Export again and you get a second voucher, so reverse the first one in Fortnox before you do.
undo.reopenBody: The voucher and the booked income statement are deleted, and the day rejoins the To book queue. It waits there until you book it again, or until the next fetch clears the queue.
undo.deleteBody: {unit}'s report, its sold items and its voucher are removed. You cannot undo that. Fetching the same period again does bring the day back.

review.alreadyBooked: {count} days in the period are already booked and cannot be booked again.
review.inFortnoxWarning: Fortnox already holds a voucher for this day and verksamhet ({voucher}). Only book this if they really are two separate reports.
review.alreadyBookedWarning: This day is already booked here and cannot be booked again. Voucher:
review.approveShortcut: Approve and book (⌘ or Ctrl + Enter). j and k change day.

findings.none: Nothing out of the ordinary. Compare the products sold with the income statement and approve.
findings.fallback: Products without a recognised prefix ended up here. Check that every line belongs here, and move the ones that belong to another committee.
findings.noCostCentre: The cost centre is missing. Choose it above before approving.
findings.edited: The voucher has been changed by hand. Check the rows before approving.

book.clearingHint: The clearing account follows from how the day was paid and cannot be changed here.
book.unknownClearingAccount: The clearing account {account} is not in the chart of accounts. Fix it under Settings → Income before booking.

booked.searchPlaceholder: Search committee, cost centre or voucher…

setup.titleBook: You can fetch income, but before you can book it

steps.service: Connect the income service. Whoever runs the app needs to set INTAKT_URL and INTAKT_TOKEN.
steps.noCommittees: Turn on sales for at least one result unit, so there is a committee to book the income to.
steps.noPrefixes: Add product prefixes to the committee. A product whose name starts with the prefix is booked to its account, so c picks up c-Cola, for example.
steps.noFallback: Choose the fallback for unknown products: which committee and which account products without a prefix are booked to.
steps.swishClearing: Choose the clearing account for Swish.
steps.zettleClearing: Choose the clearing account for Zettle.
steps.zettleFee: Choose the account for Zettle's fees.

setup.askAdmin: The steps are done under Settings → Sales, which only people with access to settings can reach. Ask someone who has it.
